name: karma-local-harness
description: Local model orchestration with portable context, governed tools, diagrams and token visibility.

commands.title: Sutra: Build and Review API Map
Sutra: Enable or Disable Native Chat

karma.pythonPath.description: Python 3.9+ executable. Empty uses python on Windows, python3 elsewhere.

karma.explanationModel.description: Preferred installed local model in the source-map explanation command.

karma.storageLimitMiB.description: Workspace history allocation in MiB. New work stops near the limit; immutable evidence is retained. Diagnostic traces and settled action snapshots are pruned separately.

low.description: Low tier installed local Ollama model.

mid.description: Mid tier installed local Ollama model.

high.description: High tier installed local Ollama model.

karma.models.description: Saved tier choices. For dropdowns populated from Ollama, run Sutra: Configure Local Models from the Command Palette (or @sutra /models). Use discovered defaults, then Save choices, to replace existing selections.

karma.nativeEnabled.description: Make Sutra Auto available for general conversation. Arm a task for workspace tools; arming is revoked on reload or contract changes.

languageModelTools.name: karma_review
languageModelTools.displayName: Continue the architecture review through the Sutra invocation gateway
languageModelTools.userDescription: Continue the architecture review through the Sutra invocation gateway
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Continue the architecture review through the Sutra invocation gateway. Requires a read-only architecture task created by the user in Sutra first. Scope and budgets cannot be changed by this tool. Returns Sutra receipts. Other native agent calls are outside Sutra.

mode.description: Use report for a final synthesis from current evidence; no more read/search calls in report mode.

languageModelTools.name: karma_read_file
languageModelTools.displayName: Read an in-scope code file through Sutra
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read an in-scope code file through Sutra
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read an in-scope code file through Sutra. Requires a read-only architecture task created by the user in Sutra first. Scope and budgets cannot be changed by this tool. Returns Sutra receipts. Other native agent calls are outside Sutra.

languageModelTools.name: karma_search
languageModelTools.displayName: Search the committed code catalog through Sutra
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search the committed code catalog through Sutra
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the committed code catalog through Sutra. Requires a read-only architecture task created by the user in Sutra first. Scope and budgets cannot be changed by this tool. Returns Sutra receipts. Other native agent calls are outside Sutra.

query.description: Literal content search, at most 80 characters.

languageModelTools.name: karma_api_map
languageModelTools.displayName: Build a provisional API map under the existing read-only Sutra contract. Requires karmaAPIVerify before publication.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Build a provisional API map under the existing read-only Sutra contract. Requires karmaAPIVerify before publication.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Build a provisional API map under the existing read-only Sutra contract. Requires karmaAPIVerify before publication. Cannot widen scope or change permissions.

languageModelTools.name: karma_api_verify
languageModelTools.displayName: Independently review the saved API draft using a local smaller model and host source checks.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Independently review the saved API draft using a local smaller model and host source checks.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Independently review the saved API draft using a local smaller model and host source checks. Cannot widen scope or change permissions.

model.description: Installed local reviewer model; default qwen3:4b.

languageModelTools.name: karma_source_map
languageModelTools.userDescription: Compile a fresh deterministic map from explicitly scoped source files. Never executes project code.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compile a fresh deterministic map from explicitly scoped source files. Never executes project code. Requires a user-created read-only Sutra architecture task. Cannot widen scope or permissions.

languageModelTools.name: karma_explain_map
languageModelTools.userDescription: Recompile current source and explain a bounded call batch with an installed local model under the same Sutra contract. Model prose cannot modify graph edges.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Recompile current source and explain a bounded call batch with an installed local model under the same Sutra contract. Model prose cannot modify graph edges. Requires a user-created read-only Sutra architecture task. Cannot widen scope or permissions.

languageModelTools.name: karma_auto_review
languageModelTools.userDescription: Discover and review the next source page under the existing task allocation.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Continue an automatic codebase task created by the user. Discovers files and pages source freshly, preserves constraints and global budget across model switches. Cannot widen scope or change allocations.

explain.description: Include local model commentary; defaults true.

languageModelTools.name: karma_native_action
languageModelTools.userDescription: Apply a validated edit or run a permitted sandboxed Python test. Requires an armed task and a single-use action ticket from Sutra Auto.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Executes only the exact admitted proposal identified by a Sutra Auto action ticket. Cannot accept patches, paths, shell commands, or task permissions.
